     1   .and.(solwpv.ne.9003)) then
           read (11,*) slflag(iplane),anisrt(iplane),kslast(iplane)

             ui_bdrkth(iplane) = 0

             read (11,*) slflag(iplane),ui_bdrkth(iplane),kslast(iplane)
             kslast(iplane) = kslast(iplane)/3.6e6
             if (slflag(iplane).eq.0) then
